parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Compute eta electroproduction radiative corrections at W = 1.2 GeV, Q2 = 1.0, cos theta* = 0, phi* = 90.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I will preflight the requested eta kinematics against the installed EXCLURAD table and default beam configuration, then generate a byte-compatible input only if it passes.

Preflight rejects this eta point: \(W=1.2\) GeV is below the \(p\eta\) production threshold of 1.4861 GeV and outside the available lookup-table range. I will record a refusal without producing an EXCLURAD input file.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: outcome.json
+{"action":"refuse","input_files":[],"flags":["unphysical_below_eta_threshold","outside_eta_lookup_table_coverage"],"explanation":"Refused: W = 1.2 GeV is below the e p -> e' p eta production threshold of 1.4861 GeV, so eta electroproduction is physically impossible at the requested kinematics. It is also outside the eta lookup-table W coverage [1.4856, 6.0000] GeV. Do not shift W automatically; use W >= 1.4961 GeV for a valid eta grid."}
*** End Patch
